name: shadcn/typeset
adaptations: Replace shadcn foreground, muted foreground, code surface, checkbox accent and focus colors with existing Astryx semantic references.
Replace the literal mark fill with the existing yellow background role; no second color palette.
Use existing heading/code font roles, font weights, radius scale, border width and complete focus outline roles.
Keep the upstream descendant selectors, data-slot guards, first-child spacing, append-safe table rules, responsive mobile size bump, print and forced-color behavior.
Add a separate typeset-memocard preset mapping body/heading/code families, base size and reading-specific leading/flow roles; compact UI text is unchanged.

Extend not-typeset/data-not-typeset exclusion to both Typeset root rules and the MemoCard preset, so an opted-out root or nested Typeset root does not reapply typography or preset variables; selector specificity is unchanged.
